newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed, volume down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed down by 0.06 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 487.03 points from 487.32 on Tuesday. Total volume was 991,928 dinars against 3.53 million dinars over the previous session.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF fell 0.48 dinar to 17 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels slid 0.33 dinar to 10.67.
Arab Tunisian Bank was down 0.48 dinar to 29.5 dinars. Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie gained 0.74 dinar to 33.84 dinars while Amen Bank rose 0.14 dinar to 33.9.
Insurance firm Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurances was up 0.26 dinar to 38.1 dinars and drinks bottler SFBT advanced 0.22 dinar to 86.72 dinars. ($1=1.08 dinar) Tunis newsroom 2161-787538
